description: Jauharabad Sugar Mills Limited is a public limited company operating one of Pakistan's oldest sugar mills. It was originally set up at Jauharabad, District Khushab, Punjab by the Thal Development Authority, and the site has been in operation for about sixty-five years. The current management acquired the company in March 2013, took over its assets and liabilities and renamed it from Kohinoor Sugar Mills Limited, since when it has carried out a balancing, modernisation and replacement programme.
